prompt: Summarize this weather report in one sentence: 'Expect partly cloudy skies today with a high of 75 degrees. Winds will be light from the northwest. There is a slight chance of scattered showers in the evening.'
response_text: Today will be partly cloudy and mild with a high of 75 degrees, light northwest winds, and a slight chance of evening showers.

criterion_scores.name: Conciseness Compliance
criterion_scores.justification: The response effectively condenses the weather report into a single sentence without unnecessary elaboration, meeting the length constraint precisely.

criterion_scores.name: Core Meaning Preservation
criterion_scores.justification: The summary captures all essential elements of the original report—partly cloudy skies, 75-degree high, light northwest winds, and evening showers chance—without omitting critical details.
